requirements.description: Follow-up user messages on an existing project start a new `run` that sends current files to Engineer; Engineer returns only changed files; a new `versions` row is created with `parent_id` pointing at the previous version.

Workbench 版本 tab: chronological timeline of versions with summary, `qa_score` badge, and a 回滚 action that sets `projects.current_version_id` and refreshes preview/code to that snapshot (no destructive delete).
Read-only share link: `projects.share_slug` minted on demand; public route loads that version's preview + code without requiring the owner's `deviceId` cookie (mutations disabled).
下载 zip exports the current version's files as a `.zip` (jszip) from the browser or a route handler.
Seed data: ≥2 completed example projects (with versions + QA scores) inserted for every new `deviceId` (or on empty home) so first paint is never a blank grid; plus the ≥4 example prompts from F2.
E2E uiJourney (`LLM_PROVIDER=mock`): iterate with a follow-up → new version appears → rollback restores prior preview content.

items.description: A follow-up run receives the current complete files; its changed-file delta is merged into a new complete snapshot whose parent is the previous version, and an empty delta does not create a version.
The follow-up action and completed new version are clear in the existing Chinese workbench interaction.
The chronological version timeline shows each summary and QA score, and rollback updates the current pointer and both preview and code to the chosen snapshot without deleting history.
Version order, summaries, QA badges, and rollback are easy to scan and visually consistent with the existing workbench.
A fresh browser without the owner's deviceId cookie loads the shared current preview and code, while public mutation requests are denied.
The public share view communicates read-only access and presents the selected version's preview and code clearly.
The downloaded ZIP is valid and contains every path and file content from the current version snapshot.
The 下载 zip action is discoverable and gives clear feedback while the current version is being exported.
For a fresh device or empty home, seeding is idempotent and supplies at least two completed examples with version snapshots and QA scores, while home retains at least four F2 example prompts.
The first home view presents seeded project cards with visible QA badges and prompt examples without a blank-grid state.

items.command: LLM_PROVIDER=mock pnpm exec playwright test e2e/iterate-versions.spec.ts
items.description: The mock uiJourney iterates a project, shows a new version, rolls back, and restores the prior preview content.
The end-to-end rollback journey visibly returns to the earlier preview and matching code while keeping both versions in history.
Pitfall absent: an empty or failed Engineer delta advances the current pointer or persists a partial version.
Pitfall absent: rollback deletes or rewrites any historical version, or leaves preview/code on a different snapshot from the selected version.
Pitfall absent: an unauthenticated public share request can mutate project or version state.
Pitfall absent: first paint has fewer than two completed seeded project cards with visible QA scores or presents an empty project grid.
Version creation is atomic: a failed persistence step leaves the previous current version intact and cannot expose a partial child snapshot.
The 版本 tab exposes the complete version order, summary, QA score, and rollback affordance in a legible workbench layout.

items.command: LLM_PROVIDER=mock pnpm exec playwright test e2e/iterate-versions.spec.ts
items.description: The mock journey gives visible completion feedback after iteration and confirms that rollback restores the first version's preview.
Pitfall absent: a child version is persisted without linking parent_id to the version whose files were supplied to Engineer.
Pitfall absent: the public share view presents mutation controls or implies that the visitor can edit the owner's project.
